briefing: Market was flat-to-neutral today (NASDAQ +0.3%, S&P 500 roughly unchanged). With $789 cash and 3 open slots, deployed into two of the top-scoring, non-overbought candidates (CE, TNGX) at medium conviction since volume-surge confirmation was missing, keeping one slot in reserve for a stronger risk-on signal.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means checking multiple technical signals together — like RSI, MACD, price vs. moving average, and trading volume — before treating a stock's upward move as trustworthy. Today's top candidates showed three of four confirming signals but lacked a volume surge, which is why they were bought at medium rather than high conviction.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在判斷股票上漲趨勢是否可靠時，同時檢視多項技術指標，例如RSI、MACD、股價與均線的關係，以及成交量。今日篩選出的候選股符合四項訊號中的三項，但缺乏成交量放大的確認，因此僅以中等信心買入，而非高信心。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with the NASDAQ up a modest 0.3% and the S&P 500 roughly flat, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts to push the market decisively in either direction. Investors appeared to be in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to major news. This kind of low-volatility drift is typical between earnings seasons and major economic data releases.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢大致持平，納斯達克指數微升0.3%，標普500指數幾乎沒有變動，反映市場缺乏強力催化因素推動明確方向。投資人普遍採取觀望態度，而非對重大消息做出反應。這種低波動的橫盤整理在財報季與重大經濟數據公佈之間相當常見。
